item.title: Contradicting CNN report, Dana White to meet Trump about White House press secretary role
item.description:
UFC CEO Dana White announced Saturday night that he will meet with US President Donald Trump at the White House on Sunday to discuss the offer to become White House press secretary. His announcement contradicts an earlier CNN report claiming that White had already turned down the position.
Speaking to reporters at a boxing event in London, White said he was heading to Washington and would be able to provide more details after the meeting. He declined to say whether he was seriously considering accepting the position, noting that he already has numerous responsibilities.
